title: Fallout 3 — MQ04 INFO Result-Script / Braun Selector Boundary Audit v1.6
question: Do any MQ04 dialogue INFO Begin/End result scripts or their conditions bind the James-specific Doc/pod/session state to Braun-side persistence, resident selection, storage, memory-carrier association, or a uniquely James-identifying UNKNOWN-user event?

findings: FO3 INFO records contain a required Script (Begin) embedded-script structure.
FO3 INFO records contain a required Script (End) embedded-script structure after the NEXT marker.
The embedded-script structure contains SCHR metadata, SCDA compiled embedded script bytes, SCTX embedded script source, local variables and SCRO referenced forms.
INFO also exposes quest/topic linkage fields sufficient to preserve dialogue provenance.
new_primary_tool_format_evidence.significance: The sought Braun-side operation can be audited at the exact INFO result-script layer rather than inferred from spoken dialogue or the MQ04 quest script alone.

xedit_dialogue_traversal_evidence.finding: xEdit's own dialogue exporter enumerates quest dialogue by following QUST ReferencedBy records to DIAL topics and then ChildGroup(DIAL) to INFO children, while reading INFO Conditions directly.
xedit_dialogue_traversal_evidence.effect: The v1.6 exporter uses the same structural route and therefore does not depend on guessed INFO filenames or topic text.

findings: DadInfo is documented as a flag used to update dialogue choices after asking about Dad.
DithersInfo is explicitly documented as being set in dialogue results.
DadDogInfo is documented as the flag set when the player learns Dad is a dog.
BraunInfo is documented as the flag set when the player is told Betty is Braun.
MQ04Script contains quest and failsafe orchestration but no direct memory-carrier serializer.
public_script_mirror_context.boundary: TTW is a public script mirror/port and is not substituted for a hash-bound official Fallout3.esm result-script export.

export_scope.route: winning MQ04 QUST -> official ReferencedBy DIAL -> ChildGroup logical DIAL -> effective non-deleted INFO

semantic_discriminators.DISCLOSURE_ONLY: DadInfo/DadDogInfo/BraunInfo assignments update what the player knows; they do not by themselves establish neural-state mutation or persistence.
semantic_discriminators.STATE_MUTATION_TRIGGER: NPCReset/reset/reload result logic can prove a privileged operational trigger but not memory export by itself.
semantic_discriminators.JAMES_SELECTOR_PERSISTENCE_CANDIDATE: One INFO result script binds a James-specific source/reference to persistence/storage/memory semantics and an operation term.
semantic_discriminators.CARRIER_BINDING_CANDIDATE: One primary result-script path binds a James-specific source to a removable carrier or carrier-class reference with directionally meaningful operation semantics.
semantic_discriminators.COMPILED_ONLY_RESULT: SCDA exists while readable SCTX source is absent; requires decompile/manual primary review rather than negative inference.

still_required_for_save_james: James-specific persistence/storage association OR James-specific selected payload evidence
transferable/removable payload compatibility with the carrier class demonstrated by Pinkerton
no circular promotion from UNKNOWN or semantic proximity

unknown_user_rule.promotion_requirement: An INFO condition/result/reference/timing path must uniquely bind the recorded UNKNOWN alteration to James rather than merely to an unregistered Vault 112 entrant.

admission_ladder.meaning: INFO response/condition/script leaf exported with exact logical INFO and DIAL provenance
DadDogInfo/BraunInfo/DadInfo or NPCReset result assignment identified
James-specific form/reference converges in one INFO result with memory/persistence/storage plus an operation term
Primary result-script semantics uniquely select James or his pod/session and persist/bind a transferable payload or storage object
James-specific payload is bound directionally to the removable memory-carrier class later compatible with Pinkerton import

next_gate.name: MQ04_REAL_ESM_INFO_RESULT_SCRIPT_AND_CONDITION_RECEIPT_v1.6
completion: Run the v1.6 xEdit exporter with exactly six official masters loaded.
Freeze SHA-256 for both TSV outputs before semantic review.
Run the verifier and list every DadDogInfo/BraunInfo/NPCReset and compiled-only INFO.
Manually review all high-priority James selector/persistence candidates and their linked forms.
If an INFO uniquely binds UNKNOWN Altered to James, promote only UNKNOWN_TO_JAMES binding.
If an INFO or linked storage path binds James-specific state to persistence/carrier semantics, promote SAVE JAMES only to the corresponding bounded level.
